findings.text: The claim that every task item is met conflicts with the findings record, which lists the rule 1 clarification as uncorrected and shows that rule 5 handles `Point.ctorIdx`. Fix: Keep the specification correction open in both plans until rule 1 states which constants Lean’s tables identify.

The header directs readers to the findings record for all open points, but folding-review findings 4 and 5 about the test docstring and the missing `macroScopes` diagnostic test appear only in the review record. Fix: Update both plan headers to distinguish owner questions from deferred review findings and link to the review records.

The blanket completion claim overlooks the requirement for separate specification commits, since `de015deec265` and `7e390e7ed528` each changed both the specification and the extractor. Fix: Record those two commits as exceptions to the separate-commit requirement.

The summary counts two review loops that stopped after four rounds, but lines 51–58 record a third loop on parsing `deriving instance` commands. Fix: Include the parser loop and identify its deferred finding about syntax extensions declared later in the module.
